Hi all —

I recreated the meeting from our side with Redwood as the organizer and included a Zoom link. Notes on the fix so you have context:
- Issue: When the original organizer is external or forwarded through Exchange, Outlook sometimes removes the ATTENDEE RSVP block and the client won’t surface the join URL.
- Workaround: Send a new invite from an internal organizer (ben_carter@redwood.ai) and set the Zoom conference in the invitation body. That preserves RSVP state for external attendees.

I attached the patched .ics (for reference) and just sent the actual calendar event to Liam and Sanjay from ben_carter@redwood.ai — you should see an invite from "Ben Carter (Redwood Inference)".

Confirmed slot: Tue Sep 7, 10:30–11:00 PT — please accept the new invite. I also added an alternate Meet link in the description in case Zoom bounces.
